common.empty: There are no items in this list.
common.emptyWindow: There are no items in this window. The next page may contain results.
common.failed: The operation could not be completed. Your input is preserved; you can retry.
common.saved: Decision recorded in the audit log.
common.reasonHint: Explain the decision without copying contact details, secrets or private content.
common.reasonInvalid: The reason must contain between {{min}} and 500 characters.
common.adminRequired: This configuration requires the platform administrator role.
common.selectNetwork: Select a network to open these tools.
common.draftNotice: Unsaved input or pending decisions are present. Complete or cancel them before changing sections or networks.
common.discardDraftConfirm: This change may discard unsaved input. Continue?
common.pendingChangeBlocked: A decision is pending. Wait for its result before changing views.

teams.title: Moderation teams
teams.lead: Capabilities are rechecked in the network. Members who are unpublished or no longer listed in the directory are shown with a neutral label.
teams.name: Team name
teams.nameInvalid: The name must contain between 2 and 100 characters.
teams.handleHint: Look up a published network member; a technical ID grants no access.
teams.handleInvalid: Enter a handle between 1 and 64 characters.
teams.notFound: No visible member matches this handle.
teams.noMembers: There are no members in this team.

appeals.title: Platform appeals
appeals.lead: Open appeals for the selected network. Every decision is recorded in the audit log.
appeals.independence: The person filing the appeal and the operator who made the original decision cannot decide this appeal.

federation.title: Federation
federation.lead: Emitters, receipts and dead letters for this network. Technical receipt does not prove that a mirror was applied.
federation.slugInvalid: Use 2 to 64 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.
federation.keyHint: Enter only the ANTSIA_FEDERATION_…_KEY reference. The key itself is configured outside the console and is never displayed.
federation.keyInvalid: The reference must follow ANTSIA_FEDERATION_…_KEY, with uppercase letters, digits or underscores (160 characters maximum).
federation.contractsHint: One contract per line. Allowing a contract does not create its business handler.
federation.contractsInvalid: Enter up to 32 distinct contracts in CONTRACT-V1 format, with at most 100 characters each.
federation.replayHint: Replay preserves the receipt and its envelope. A contract without a business handler will still fail.

outcome.deduplicated: The receipt is already applied. No additional processing was performed.
outcome.still_failing: The replay was recorded, but processing still fails. No mirror was applied.

pages.title: Pages and trust
pages.lead: Trust levels come from the engine. Official status is reserved for institutions and a recorded administrative decision.
pages.creationHint: This creates an Official institutional page. Visibility stays within the network; it grants no badge to a person.
pages.name: Institution name
pages.nameInvalid: The name must contain between 1 and 120 characters.
pages.handleInvalid: Enter 3 to 60 lowercase characters: letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
pages.countryHint: Two uppercase ISO letters, for example GA.
pages.countryInvalid: Use two uppercase country letters or leave this field empty.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.lead: Dated operational tracking. Incidents are resolved without deleting their audit history.
incidents.networkScope: The incident will belong to the selected network.
incidents.globalScope: The incident will belong to the platform.
incidents.name: Incident title
incidents.titleHint: Describe the operational issue without personal data.
incidents.titleInvalid: The title must contain between 2 and 160 characters.

audit.title: Decision audit log
audit.networkLead: Recorded decisions in the selected network, newest first.
audit.globalLead: Recorded decisions across the platform, newest first.
audit.subjectLead: History of the selected subject. No technical details or private content are exported.

health.title: Network health
health.lead: Materialised queue and member counts. These numbers describe the engine; they do not prove provider availability.
health.notGenerated: No counts have been generated yet. Request a calculation to obtain a dated state.
health.building: Calculation is running in batches. Incomplete values are not shown as a final state.
health.dateMissing: The date of this count is unavailable.
health.queued: Calculation requested. Wait for the new dated state.
health.snapshotHint: Calculation spans several batches; this is a dated state, not an atomic snapshot of every table.

export.title: Aggregate export
export.lead: At most twelve periods, without identities or free text. Privacy threshold: {{threshold}} cases and distinct authors.
export.suppressionHint: Small cohorts and sub-cohorts are suppressed. A suppressed value is not zero and is not reconstructed in the export.
export.failed: The file could not be downloaded. You can retry.
export.invalid: This aggregate projection cannot be exported; download is blocked.
